title: Backtest exclusion details
description: Expand events to distinguish possible withdrawal/replacement field differences from ID conflicts and missing scoring data, with exact coverage percentages. Strict scoring checks remain unchanged.

title: Expanded backtest history
description: Recovered genuine pre-event prediction files from Git history and added DataGolf ID matching. Coverage checks stay strict, original archives remain unchanged, and recovered sources are identified in the audit.

title: Final pre-tournament backtests
description: Future backtests prefer the latest saved evening-before prediction to better reflect field changes. Initial runs remain available, with local-time capture cutoffs and an initial-snapshot fallback.

title: Duplicate-player safeguards
description: New checks stop duplicate golfers entering simulations or published archives. Duplicate rows were removed from the 3M Open and Corales archives, allowing the 3M Open to qualify for backtest scoring.
